title: Cars. Lightning McQueen.
lines: In the world of cars lives a very fast race car.
With a big yellow lightning bolt on his side and the number ninety-five.
Lightning takes part in big races.
Thousands of cars sit in the stands cheering.
He wants only one thing: to win the big race and get the Piston Cup, the biggest cup of all.
But Lightning is also a bit of a show-off.
He thinks he can do everything on his own.
After one race he ties with two other cars.
There will be a new race in California.
Lightning wants to get there as fast as possible.
He rides in a big truck called Mack.
Some naughty cars come and tease him.
The door opens, and Lightning rolls out onto the big road.
He drives very fast into a little town.
A police car comes after him.
Lightning gets a fright, and he races through the town, over posts, through flowers and over the road.
He drags a statue along with him.
And the whole road is broken!
The next morning Lightning has to go to the judge.
The judge is an old, blue car.
You broke our road, he says.
So you have to fix the road!
Lightning has to pull a big, heavy machine called Bessie.
Bessie spits hot, black tar onto the road.
Lightning has to make the whole road again.
But in Radiator Springs Lightning finds a new friend.
It's an old, rusty, brown tow truck with big teeth and a hook on his back.
Mater is funny and super kind.
Mater is really good at driving backwards.
I don't need to see where I'm going, I just need to know where I've been!
Mater takes Lightning to the field at night.
And do you know what they do?
And the tractors get such a fright that they fall over.
He has never had so much fun.
The other cars in the town become his friends too.
Luigi and Guido, who sell tyres.
And Flo, who sells fuel in her café.
It turns out Doc used to be a very famous race car himself!
He teaches Lightning how to take a corner well on the dirt.
The little town is pretty again and full of lights.
But his friends from Radiator Springs are there too!
Doc is his coach and Mater helps with the tyres.
Lightning takes the corner the way Doc taught him.
But just before the end an old race car has a crash.
Lightning stops, just before the finish.
He goes back and pushes the old car over the finish line.
But everyone claps and cheers for him.
Lightning has learned something: having friends is much more important than winning cups.
And he goes to live in Radiator Springs, near his very best friend Mater.
